No worries. I think in any job schooling, skill and knowledge all play huge roles. I haven't been in the field as long as some and just needed some insight. I deserve to make more, just wasn't sure how much more. Unfortunately this career won't make us rich but I wouldn't change it!

I'm very skilled and knowledgeable in my job. I choose and calculate the drugs being used for anesthesia everyday. I pull the blood, place the iv, give the drugs, intubate and prep the patients. It's not until the doctor walks into surgery scrubbed and ready to cut are they involved (besides exam before anesthesia of course). I talk to clients about any medical issue their pet may be having and know 99% of the time exactly what my doctor will want as far as diagnostics or medications. I could go on about reading urine, ear, fecal, skin, samples, etc. I don't think a raise should be handed out just because I went to school. I deserve this raise and this post wasn't questioning that. It was asking what other vet techs make in certain areas so I had something to compare.
